description.en: Neo Zeon from "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack Beltorchka Children"

description.ja: ニュータイプ専用MSであるサイコ・ドーガがHGスケールでついに初の立体化！
description.en: Newtype exclusive MS Psycho Doga is finally made into 3D for the first time in HGScale!

description.ja: 「GUNDAM SIDE-F」で先行販売いたします。
• 独特な形状の頭部形状や背中の3本のバインダーを新規造形で再現。モノアイは可動式。
description.en: • The unique head shape and three binders on the back are reproduced with new modeling. Monoeye is movable.

description.ja: • 両肩に3基ずつファンネルを装備、展開状態を差し替えで表現が可能。
description.en: • Equipped with 3 funnels on each shoulder, the expanded state can be expressed by replacing them.

description.ja: • 各部関節が可動、特に腹部は上下左右に大胆に可動。様々なポージングが楽しめる。
description.en: • All joints are movable, especially the abdomen can move vertically and horizontally. You can enjoy various poses.

description.ja: • 頭部・シールドのネオ・ジオンマークはパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: • The neo-Zeon mark on the head and Seal is reproduced by dividing the parts.

description.ja: ※後日、プレミアムバンダイ（バンダイナムコグループ公式通販サイト）、THE GUNDAM BASE各店でも販売予定です。
description.en: *Later, it will be sold at Premium Bandai (Bandai Namco Group official mail order site) and THE GUNDAM BASE stores.
